documentation.file_docstring: SRE Server Lifecycle Manager Manages a local agent-failsafe REST server subprocess. Spawns on activation, health-checks, and kills on deactivation. The extension owns the server lifecycle — no user setup required.
inline_comments: Validate a Python path is non-empty and free of shell metacharacters. spawn() uses array args (no shell: true), so metacharacters cannot cause injection — this regex is defense-in-depth. Null bytes are rejected to prevent path truncation attacks on POSIX systems.
Check if agent-failsafe is importable by the given Python interpreter. @param pythonPath - Path to Python executable @returns true if agent_failsafe.rest_server is importable
Prompt the user to install agent-failsafe and run pip install. @param pythonPath - Path to Python executable @returns true if installation succeeded
Manages the lifecycle of a local agent-failsafe REST server. Spawns `python -m agent_failsafe.rest_server` as a child process, waits for it to become healthy, and provides the loopback endpoint.
Start the REST server and wait for it to become healthy. @returns Result with endpoint URL if successful
Check if something is already running on the port
